title: Ecclesiastical History
author: socrates-scholasticus
attributionNote: The attribution is recorded as the edition and the scholarly consensus give it; where the attribution is disputed, the work says so.
description: A church history from Constantine to 439, written in Constantinople by a lawyer. It preserves letters and documents from the Arian controversy, including Arius's own letters, together with the councils of Nicaea and Constantinople.
historicalContext: Written by a layman who relied on documentary sources rather than a bishop's archive, and who says so when he doubts a report.
availabilityNote: Streamed from the CCEL volume page at read time. Zenos's translation from the Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, second series, volume 2, served by the CCEL. Documents quoted within the history are reproduced as the translation prints them.
